pre_condition: edges is an iterable of CallEdge objects.
post_condition: Returns a list of CallEdge objects where no two entries share the same caller fully-qualified name and callee fully-qualified name. For entries with the same caller FQN and callee FQN, the returned entry contains the union of all distinct callsite_names and the union of all distinct info_names from all occurrences of that pair, and takes the source from the first occurrence. The relative order of first occurrences of each unique (caller.fqn, callee.fqn) pair is preserved.
